description: Read the extracted CONTENT of an uploaded document (PDF, Word .docx, Excel .xlsx, PowerPoint, text). Excel comes as one Markdown table per sheet ('## Blatt: <name>', header row, first column 'Zeile' = Excel row number); Word with headings, list items and tables. Use search_knowledge to find WHICH document/rows are relevant, then this tool for the exact rows. Required: document_id (from list_documents / search_knowledge source.document_id). Optional: sheet (Excel sheet name, exact or partial), query (only rows/lines containing ALL words, case-insensitive; "quoted phrase" stays together; table rows come with their header), max_chars (default 20000, max 100000), offset (continue where next_offset points). Returns { document_id, title, sheets?, text, total_chars, truncated, next_offset?, matches?, source }. Read-only.

offset.description: Start position in the (filtered) text — from next_offset.

query.description: Only rows/lines containing all these words (e.g. 'Beispiel' or '"Beispiel GmbH" EDI').

sheet.description: Excel: only this sheet (name, exact or partial).

name: get_document_text
